{"name":"general","code":"def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    # mode 1: repeated 32-bit xorshift
    mode = int(inputs.get('MODE', 1))
    if mode == 1:
        x = int(inputs['X'])
        a, b, c, k = map(int, (inputs['A'], inputs['B'], inputs['C'], inputs['K']))
        mask = (1 << int(inputs.get('BITS', 32))) - 1
        for _ in range(k):
            x ^= (x << a) & mask
            x &= mask
            x ^= x >> b
            x &= mask
            x ^= (x << c) & mask
            x &= mask
        return float(x)
    return 0.0"}
